column1: # Hashes this image replaces: one `<target><TAB><hash>` line per previously
# shipped version of a managed source. A home-volume copy whose hash is here is
# ours and gets replaced; anything else is assumed to be user-edited and is
# left alone. Append the old hash in the same commit that changes the source.
# Empty until the first content change after the mechanism landed.
# 0.3.0: agents.md is now aimed at every variant, so the baked-tools paragraph
# is flavor-neutral and the old full-image wording is retired. slim keeps
# shipping this same registry chain, which is also what lets a home volume move
# between flavors: one source means one hash history.
